    • menuCategory

      public @NonNull CustomBlock.Builder menuCategory(@Nullable BlockMenuCategory menuCategory)
      Sets the description's menu_category: the category, group and is_hidden_in_commands the add-on JSON gives. It alone decides whether the block item is in the creative inventory, as in BDS; without it, or with category none, it is not. An item that replaces the block item has a menu_category of its own.
      Parameters:
      menuCategory - the menu category, or null for none
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • tags

      public @NonNull CustomBlock.Builder tags(@NonNull String first, @NonNull String @NonNull ... rest)
      Adds block tags, queryable with Molang, to the block's BlockTags component (created if there is none). Tags it has already are skipped. This and component(BlockTags) are one mechanism: the component holds the tags.
      Parameters:
      first - the first tag
      rest - the other tags
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
